messages.subject: CEO Office role at Oleria
messages.body:
Hi Jagadeesh,

Your post about the CEO Office role describes strategy and executive business operations that run alongside you. That is close to how I worked at Ola Electric, where I partnered with the CEO and COO on fulfilment operations and owned finished goods inventory end-to-end.

I worked on GTM strategies for multiple products at Ola Electric (BESS, 4680 Cell and multiple new variants launched) while managing production planning and inventory management side by side. I executed multiple strategies and was a notable contributor to increasing serviceability of OLA electric to 70% and, in parallel, decreasing O2D from 30 to 14 days during peak seasons.

I do not have an MBA. I am an IIT Guwahati engineer who has done this kind of work for a year.

I would like to be considered. Could we speak for 15 minutes this week?

Regards
messages.hook: His own post hiring for the CEO Office: strategy and executive business operations, MBA preferred

messages.subject: Chief of Staff, Manufacturing (Chennai)
messages.body:
Hi Rajalakshmi,

Your post for a Chief of Staff to the Head of Manufacturing in Chennai lists plant performance and business reviews, which is the work I did at Ola Electric. I owned S&OP production planning there, built 3-month rolling production plans, and drove backend production planning for the 4680 cell line, where yield rose from 42% to 67% in two months.

I have about 1.3 years of full-time experience, so if your client needs someone more senior, a quick no is useful. If not, I would like to be considered. Could you tell me what you need from me to take it forward?

Shlok
messages.hook: Her post for a Chief of Staff to the Head of Manufacturing in Chennai: plant performance and business reviews

messages.subject: Founder's Office role at Carbon Trail
messages.body:
Hi Carbon Trail team,

A LinkedIn jobs roundup listed a remote Founder's Office role at Carbon Trail. I could not find the listing on your site, so I am writing directly.

A fashion brand's footprint is largely decided by its supply chain and inventory, which is where I spent the last year. At Ola Electric, I ran S&OP planning over Rs 200 Cr of inventory and led a pan-India rebalancing of non-moving stock that unlocked 27% working capital. I believe my experience in Supply chain and operations will be useful in S&OP at Carbon Trail.

If the role is open, I would like to be considered.

Regards,
Shlok Agrawal
